Name: Perfect Fruit cometkins style
Author: sugarmaples
Description:
Pretty much what it says on the tin! This mod is JUST an image, so please go into the folder for perfect fruit and replace the original "Objects.png" with this one. If anyone has any questions please let me know!!

This wouldn't have been possible without [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/cometkins/mods?gameId=1303]cometkins[/url]' sprites! Please go and download their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url] mod. they've given blanket permission for use and editing their sprites since they're no longer active. 

It also, of course, relies on [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/TheAppleSauceIsStale?gameId=1303]TheAppleSauceIsStale[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38413]Perfect Fruit[/url] mod! A wonderful addition to my game and one I've been enjoying a TON. Please go give them kudos!

I edited the sprites myself, but all credit for pretty much everything goes to those two, they did the real heavy lifting here!
